text: A lot since you were last here. A crew with a name, a project and favours owed. Comps with rounds and a clock. The van ages, and you lay it out. Your body keeps count after thirty, and someone carries on after you. A canyon the map leaves out. Cards at the fire, played properly. Sessions with the locals, your best go climbing beside you, each crag’s classics, Hazel’s three moves, the radio’s forecast, a rope to hold, holds to set. And a problem of the day, the same for everyone.

Your climber can leave as a file and come back: Settings has Export your save, and the first screen has Import a save. A controller works on every screen now, its buttons yours to move in Settings. The marks the handwriting never had, the ticks, the crosses and the suits, are drawn now instead of guessed at. And if the game breaks, it says so instead of going blank, with your save where you left it.
